# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We currently support the latest stable version of `pybandits`.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, **please do not open an issue**.

Instead, email us at [shaharbar1@gmail.com] with:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact

We aim to respond within 5 working days and will work with you on a fix and coordinated disclosure if needed.
